tools.name: aexy_api
tools.description: Call any Aexy API endpoint directly. Use this for endpoints not covered by dedicated tools, or when you need full control over the request. The base URL already points to /api/v1, so paths should be relative (e.g., '/health', '/developers/me', '/workspaces/{id}/teams').

tools.name: temporal_cancel_workflow
tools.description: Cancel or terminate a workflow execution with a reason.

tools.name: temporal_describe_workflow
tools.description: Get full description of a workflow execution — status, type, queue, start/close times, history length, pending activities.

tools.name: temporal_get_workflow_history
tools.description: Key debugging tool. Parse workflow event history into a readable timeline showing activity starts/completions, failures with details, retry counts, signals, timers, and child workflows.

tools.name: temporal_list_schedules
tools.description: List all registered Temporal schedules with intervals, next run times, and paused status.

tools.name: temporal_list_workflows
tools.description: List Temporal workflow executions. Supports filtering by status, type, and time range using Temporal visibility queries.

tools.name: temporal_query_workflow
tools.description: Query a running workflow's state. For example, query 'get_status' on CRMAutomationWorkflow to see current node, or custom query handlers.

tools.name: temporal_signal_workflow
tools.description: Send a signal to a running workflow. Examples: 'on_event' to CRMAutomationWorkflow, 'pause'/'resume' to OutreachSequenceWorkflow.

tools.name: temporal_system_status
tools.description: Aggregate Temporal dashboard: workflow counts by status/type, recent failures, schedule health overview.
